top_signals.title: Ingenia Soars on Fresh $1.6 Billion Takeover Bid From AVID
top_signals.summary: Ingenia Communities Group shares soared following a takeover bid from AVID Property Group Holdings, as a bidding war ramps up for the owner of Australian retirement living accommodation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
